domain_and_universes: Open: the source must fix finite alphabets, input encodings, the machine model and space measure, polynomial-space membership, and the source and target types used by the reduction.
conclusion: Open: no decision problem is named, so neither PSPACE membership nor PSPACE hardness has a fixed subject.
excluded_degenerate_cases: Not yet frozen. Empty alphabets, malformed encodings, empty inputs, partial decoders, rejection/halting conventions, polynomial bounds, and encoding invariance must follow an exact source statement.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical logic and choice policy are not frozen because the proposition is not selected
tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are the intended base; exact imports, a space-complexity layer, and transitive declaration closure remain open
computation_profile: No executable run, oracle, experiment, or unchecked complexity certificate is credited; the eventual claim must quantify over a formal machine semantics and checked resource bounds
formal_system: Lean 4 + mathlib under the rev-5.6 adapter
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source selection, named complete problem, reduction convention, encoding, machine/resource model, Lean target, toolchain, mathlib pin, assurance profile, or validator change; review due date and independent reviewers remain open.
status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. Candidate Lean APIs elaborate, but no unique source theorem or canonical Lean target is selected. No H0, M0, R0, accepted proof state, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
